title: Revise the Client Registry minimum dataset for necessity and inclusion
requirements:
- Distinguish schema support, conditional requirement and mandatory presence; allow documented absent-data reasons
- Reassess mandatory status of nationality, address, contact, sex at birth and gender identity against stated purposes
- Support flexible names, date precision and estimated dates, no-fixed-address and unknown/not-disclosed values
- Separate sex- and gender-related concepts with inclusive, governed value sets
- Apply data-minimisation and impact assessment to the whole dataset, not only biometrics
